study type: Retrospective analysis with AI model application
exposure: NLP model application with varying threshold settings (F-score 0.5 vs F-score 2)
outcome: Detection of seven types of postoperative complications (PCs)
Trends in PC rates over time
cohort: The study analyzed 100,505 surgical cases from 12 Danish hospitals.
finding: NLP models can be effectively used for automated detection of postoperative complications, but the choice of threshold settings significantly influences the observed complication rates and impacts hospital comparisons.
